name: Nummela BackYard Ultra
description: Nummela Backyard Ultra is an ultramarathon running event in which competitors run 6.706-kilometre loops within an hour for as long as multiple runners are able to continue. The race is unique because it has no predetermined finish time or distance, and the winner is the person who runs one more loop than the others. The event is held at Polku Hotel in Vihti and offers a challenge for runners who value perseverance and endurance. The race originated in the United States and is also known as “Just one more Loop.”
course_highlights: A 6.706-kilometre route to be completed in under an hour
The race continues for as long as multiple runners can complete a loop within an hour
There are often separate daytime and nighttime routes; the nighttime route is less technical
additional: The race uses a start bell that rings every hour. Runners must be in the designated area when the bell rings. Timing may be done on paper or electronically, and timing services are provided by Juha Seppälä (info@nubu.fi). The race ends when only one runner completes a loop within the one-hour time limit. The event is held at Polku Hotel in Vihti and offers the opportunity to take part in an ultramarathon and follow the runners’ progress via GPS.

name: Puuluoto Backyard
description: Puuluoto Backyard 2025 will take place on Saturday, 18 October 2025, from 9:00 to 21:00 on a peaceful forest trail on a crisp October day when the temperature is one or two degrees below zero. Are you ready to challenge yourself? Welcome to our backyard-style running event! The 6.7-kilometre loop is run once every hour, and you can take part in either the six-loop race (6 hours) or try to complete the full 12-loop distance (12 hours). We promise runners fun activities together, some easy kilometres and some a little more challenging, plus the trail-running community’s endless encouragement.

name: Hiidenkierros
distance_verbose: 13.2 km, 10 km, 10 km, 5 km, 5 km, 3000 metriä
description: The Hiidenkierros trail running event will take place next autumn on Saturday, 18 October. The event offers several distances, including 3–5 km routes suitable for families and schoolchildren, as well as the more challenging Kitulankierros (10.5 km). The Hiidenkierros loop route winds through the magnificent scenery of Hiidenportti National Park, with dramatic gorge valleys and beautiful lake views along the way. The route is challenging, but also offers places to take a break, making it an excellent destination for a day trip.

images.alt_text: Hiidenkierroksen maalaismaisemaa: vanhoja rakennuksia ja aitoja.

name: Solvalla Trail
description: Solvalla Trail is a trail running event where the SAUL Finnish Championships are being held for the first time. All age groups compete on the 10-kilometre course, with a choice of 10 or 20 kilometres; participants in the longer race complete the loop twice. The route winds through varied terrain, mostly along narrow trails, and features impressive rocky cliffs, stunning coastal scenery and beautiful forests. The highlight of the course is an almost 75-metre climb to the top of Swinghill.

description: Hiidenkierros is a trail running event held in the Neitvuori area of Mikkeli. The routes pass through beautiful lake scenery and along technical trails, offering runners varied terrain such as rocky outcrops and the shores of forest ponds. The event headquarters are at the idyllic Hiidenmaa farm, creating a unique atmosphere. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and also offers a 4 km distance for children.
course_highlights: Neitvuori rises 100 metres straight up from Lake Saimaa
The route features many technical trail sections and beautiful lake views
Several lean-to shelters and campfire sites serve as aid stations
additional: The race office and café are open from 9:00 to 18:00. Registration at the race office is open from 9:00 to 10:30; on-site registration is also available. A guided group warm-up starts at 10:40. Timing chips are worn on both feet. There are aid stations along the route with energy drink and energy chews. There is a toilet at the event headquarters, but no indoor facilities or washing facilities. Food and drinks are available at the race café. The route is well marked with wooden signs and plastic tape. The longer routes include a two-way trail section where runners must keep to the right. route and registration information, family and children’s routes, online shop

name: Kaarinan Syysmaraton
description: Kaarina Autumn Marathon is a running event offering several distances for different age groups, including marathon, half marathon, and 10 km races, open to both men and women. The races take place on an approximately 10.5-kilometre loop through beautiful, flat terrain in Kaarina and Piikkiö. A children’s run is also held, with the youngest children running an approximately 150-metre loop and older children an approximately 500-metre loop. All participants receive a medal, and the children’s run is free with no advance registration required.

name: Kankaanpää Maraton
description: Kankaanpää Marathon is a versatile running event offering races over various distances, including the marathon, half marathon, and shorter distances. The event takes place in Kankaanpää and is known for its beautiful scenery and well-maintained courses. Participants can enjoy running surrounded by nature, and the event attracts both recreational and competitive runners. To celebrate its 20th anniversary, the event returns to Niinisalo School, Kievarinkatu 3.

name: Pukinmaki Run Helsinki 18.10.2026
description: Pukinmäki Run is an annual running event held in the Pukinmäki district of Helsinki, offering distances of 1 km for children, 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The route is flat and fast, mainly on asphalt and outdoor trails, and loops around the boundaries of Pukinmäki. The event is open to runners of all ages and abilities, offering the chance to enjoy exercise and beautiful nature together with others. The event centre is located at Pukinmäki Sports Park, where refreshments and snacks are available.
course_highlights: Flat road and outdoor trail route, approximately 85% asphalt
Only 4.9 metres of elevation gain, making for a fast course
The route loops around the boundaries of the Pukinmäki district
additional: Advance registration closes on 13.10.2026 at 21:00. Late registration is available on Saturday 17.10 from 14:00 to 16:00 and on Sunday 18.10 at the race office. Bib collection begins on Sunday 18.10 at 11:00. The children's 400 m and 1 km races start at 14:20. The race lasts 3 hours; the course closes at 17:00. The event centre is located at Pukinmäki Sports Park, Kenttätie 3, Helsinki. The route is mainly asphalt, and the event offers refreshments and snacks. Participants can travel to the event by car, train, bus or plane. Registration opens well ahead of the event.

name: Pukinmaki Run 1/2 Maraton 10k 5k
description: Pukinmäki Run is an annual running event held in the Pukinmäki district of Helsinki. The officially measured distances are 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, as well as a 1 km children’s race. The route follows the borders of Pukinmäki and is a flat road course, with approximately 85% asphalt, 10% compacted crushed stone and 5% running track. The course is fast to run, with an elevation difference of just 4.9 metres.

name: Halloween Hike
description: Halloween Hike 2024 gives children the chance to enjoy Halloween without scary elements. The event takes place at Memphis Boo-tanic Garden and offers a safe alternative to traditional door-to-door trick-or-treating. Participants can enjoy craft activities, not-so-scary characters, and treats. Costumes are encouraged, and this year the garden has introduced timed entry, so it’s a good idea to buy tickets in advance.

name: Helsinki Halloween Run
description: Helsinki Halloween Run 2025 takes place on 25.10.2025 in Kalasatama, Helsinki! The event also includes a race for children, Kids Run Helsinki Halloween, with distances of approximately 450 m (for children under 7) and 900 m (for older children). Schedule: 16.00 Race office opens, 17.45 Kids Run 450 m, 18.00 Kids Run 900 m, and 18.30 start of the 5 km and 10 km races. Prizes will be awarded for the best costumes during the event, and a photo wall will be available for capturing the costumes.

name: Mustavuori Vertical
description: Mustavuori Vertical takes over the Mustavuori Ski Resort in Tampere on 28 October 2023! Participants climb the slope by walking, Nordic walking, jogging, bounding or even running. What makes the event special is that each ascent starts together at the bottom. The race is designed to be a challenging, communal experience, where the winner is the one who lasts the longest.

name: Sarvilahden Maraton
description: Sarvilahti Marathon offers participants several different running distances, including the marathon, half marathon, and 5- and 10-kilometer routes. The marathon and half marathon follow the same route, with the half marathon completed twice. The event provides electronic timing, and the maximum time for the marathon is 6 hours. All participants receive a medal, but medals cannot be guaranteed for those who register late.

name: Lepokallion lenkki
description: Lepokallio Trail is a 5.8-kilometer hiking route in the varied forest landscapes of Hanhikoski, Ylistaro. It was renovated and is maintained by the Hanhikoski Rural and Home Economics Women's Association. There are two lean-to shelters along the route, Lepokallio Shelter and Pururata Shelter, both with a fire pit and firewood. The route is accessible year-round and offers an easy outing through varied terrain, including bright pine forests and atmospheric spruce forests.

name: Viikin Viitonen
description: Viikin Viitonen is an event open to everyone, held several times a year. This year, the event will be run on July 1, bringing runners together in the atmosphere of a summer evening. The event has set a new record with 106 participants, and the current maximum number of participants is 150. Advance registration and the entry fee cost 10 euros (incl. 10% VAT).

name: Tuusula Trailrun
description: Tuusula Trailrun 2024 trail race will be held on Sunday, 27 October 2024 at 11:00 at the biathlon stadium of Tuusula Sports Centre. The route runs along the trails of Tuusula’s Korpikylä and Sammaloja, offering varied terrain and wide, runnable trails. Trail running shoes or studded shoes are the most suitable, but the route can also be run safely in regular running shoes. There are water stations on the course at the 5 km, 10 km and 15 km marks, and the route is marked with ribbons, signs and chalk.

images.alt_text: Ilmakuva urheilukeskuksesta, mahdollisesti Tuusula Trailrunin lähtöpaikka.

name: Hiidenhölkkä Nummela
description: As autumn approaches, so does the traditional Hiidenhölkkä, which is being held for the 47th time this year. Hiidenhölkkä–Nummelan Tarmo. The 10 km and 20 km (2 x 10 km) Hiidenhölkkä routes circle Nummelanharju and Nummela Airport. Hiidenhölkkä starts at 12:00, and the running event ends at 14:00.

name: Pilvimaja Night Trail
description: Pilvimaja Night Trail is a unique trail running event held in the Vaasa area. The event gives runners the chance to experience beautiful scenery and the calming effects of nature in the dark, on a reflective-marked course. The distance is approximately 13 km, and the event takes place on Friday, October 31, 2025, at 20:00.

images.alt_text: Pilvimaja Night Trail Run logo. Polkujuoksutapahtuma Skatilassa, Suomessa.

name: Vantaan Kestävyyskierros
description: At the Vantaa Endurance Series, you can challenge yourself in five different events. The series is suitable for fitness enthusiasts and endurance athletes of all levels, and offers a great opportunity to try completely new sports. The Vantaa Endurance Series consists of Vantaa Ski Race, Vantaa Off-trail Challenge orienteering, Vantaa Triathlon, Seutula Loop and Vantaa Marathon. The events are standalone competitions, but together they make up the Vantaa Endurance Series.

name: Repovesi Trail 2026
description: Repovesi Trail 2026 is a trail running event held in Repovesi National Park on Saturday, 31 October 2026. The event offers three challenging distances: 10 km, 21 km and 42 km, taking runners through stunning natural scenery among rugged cliffs and forest views. The routes are clearly marked and feature varied terrain, offering a challenge for experienced runners and new adventurers alike. The event centre is at the Lapinsalmi car park, a short distance from the start of the route.
course_highlights: The routes follow the established trails of Repovesi National Park
Climbs, rugged cliffs and stunning forest views
The 21 km main route is run twice for the 42 km distance; the 10 km route takes a shortcut from the main route
additional: The event centre is at the Lapinsalmi car park, address Riippusillantie 55, 47900 Vuohijärvi. The race has a limit of 100 participants per distance, 300 in total. The finish closes at 18:00. Parking is available near the event centre. Runners must use their own cup at drink stations. Baba Foods smoothies, Maxim sports drink, sweets, crisps, bananas and raisins are available at the finish. After the race, a buffet meal is served at Restaurant Prinssi, with continuous bus transport to the car park. Route provisions include marking and aid stations; the event is environmentally friendly and offers prizes to participants.

name: Pohjoisbaanan maili 2026
description: Pohjoisbaanan Mile 2026 is a traditional mile race held on Pohjoisbaanan in Käpylä, Helsinki, on October 31. The race gives runners the chance to test their pace over one mile (1.609 km). The start is on the pedestrian and cycle path near Käpylä railway station, and the event is open to all running enthusiasts. The event is organized by Helsingin Juoksijat ry, and participation is free for members. Welcome to enjoy a fast-paced, community-minded running event!
course_highlights: The distance is exactly one mile, or 1.609 km
The start is on the pedestrian and cycle path near Käpylä railway station
The event takes place on Pohjoisbaanan in Käpylä, Helsinki
additional: Participation is free for members of Helsingin Juoksijat ry. The start location is marked by a Helsingin Juoksijat flag. The event lasts about an hour, from 11:00 to 12:00. The event starts at 10:00, and no information is available about specific course features or registration procedures. Helsingin Juoksijat also offers a variety of running training and community events throughout the year.

name: Komia Ilkan Polku
location: Ilmajoella Kyrkösjärven läheisyydessä, Ilmajoki, South Ostrobothnia, Finland
description: KOMIA Ilkan Polku is a varied and challenging trail-running event held in Ilmajoki near Kyrkösjärvi. The event offers several distances, including a 39 km marathon, a 20 km half marathon, a 10 km sprint, and the children’s Halloween Run. The route follows a variety of trails and village roads, with approximately 300 metres of elevation gain. The event centre is at Luontokeskus Käpälikkö on the shore of Kyrkösjärvi, where runners can enjoy beautiful natural scenery and challenging sections. The event is also family-friendly and encourages participants to dress in a Halloween theme.
course_highlights: Varied trails along the Ilkan Polku nature trail
Approximately 300 metres of total elevation gain
The route also includes approximately 3 km of village roads and gravel roads
additional: The event has mass starts, bag storage, and bag transport from the start to the finish area. The café serves coffee, sweets, sausages, and drinks. First-aid points are located along the route and at the finish. Changing facilities, showers, and toilets are available in the changing rooms at Kyrkösjärvi beach. Littering in nature is prohibited. The children’s Halloween Run is free and encourages participants to dress up in costume. The event includes various categories, the route, timing, prizes, a café, soup, bag storage, toilets at Kyrkösjärvi beach, a recommendation to have insurance, first aid, and the opportunity to test running shoes.

name: Fiskarin Halloween 10K
description: Helsinki Halloween Run 2025 takes place on 25 October 2025! The event also includes a children’s race, Kids Run Helsinki Halloween, with distances of approximately 450 m (for children under 7) and 900 m (for older children). The route is officially measured, and the competition has 5 km and 10 km categories for men and women. The best Halloween costume will be awarded a prize!

images.alt_text: Halloween-teemainen kuva juoksutapahtumaan. Musta linna, lepakkoja ja kurpitsa. Teksti: Halloween Hölkkä 5.11.2022.

name: Riston Hölkkä
description: Risto’s Run is held in Suomusjärvi, Salo, every year on the Sunday after All Saints’ Day. The event is named after Risto Nuuroks, a four-time World Championship medalist in orienteering who won silver in the individual event in 1978. Competitive and recreational categories are available for runners of all abilities, and the routes pass through rural landscapes, mostly on gravel roads. Risto’s Run will next be held on 2 November 2025, with the race headquarters at Sisumaja.

name: Fiskarsin Maraton Rasepori
description: Fiskars Marathon Raasepori will be held on 20.06.2025, starting from the Fiskari Athletes’ lodge. The race starts at 10:00. The entire route follows gravel roads, offering runners a range of distances, including 15 km, 7 km, 1.5 km and 0.5 km. The event is a perfect opportunity for both beginners and experienced runners seeking a challenge and beautiful scenery. All participants receive a commemorative medal.

images.alt_text: Fiskarsin kylä lintuperspektiivistä, jossa sijaitsee juoksureitti.

name: Tampere Races
description: Tampere Marathon 2025 will be run on Sunday, August 31. You can choose to run the marathon, half marathon, quarter marathon (10.5 km), or take part in the marathon relay, run in teams of four. Children have their own Mini Marathon event at Tampere Stadium. The course has changed compared with previous years due to construction work in the city, and runs mainly on asphalt and partly on gravel paths.

name: Fiskarsin Maraton Raseporis 2026
description: The Fiskars Marathon in Raseborg 2026 is an exciting running event that gives participants the opportunity to experience magnificent scenery and a sense of community. The event attracts runners of all levels and is an excellent opportunity to test your fitness and enjoy running. The marathon is designed to offer unforgettable moments for both competitors and spectators.

name: Itämeri Maraton
description: Baltic Sea Marathon will be run and walked on Saturday, October 4, 2025. The distance options are the marathon, half marathon, and quarter marathon (10.5 km). The official time limit is six (6) hours for the full marathon and 5.5 hours for the half marathon and quarter marathon. The course is officially measured, and the start and finish area are at Keskuskoulu, Halmstadinkatu 2. Advance registration closes on Tuesday, September 30, 2025, at 24:00.

name: Keurusselän Syyslenkki
description: Keurusselkä Autumn Run takes place on the grounds of Hotel Keurusselkä and in the sports park, mainly following ski trails. The event is held on Saturday, October 4 at 11:00, with 6 km and 10 km routes. The start and finish are at Hotel Keurusselkä, and a prize containing local products will be raffled among runners in both distances. The entry fee is €15, which includes use of the hotel spa after the run.

description: Ilmaristen Ympärijuoksu is a running event held on 06.10.2024 from 11:00 to 13:00. The event takes place at Ilmaristen Metsäpirtti, Pahkalaukkaantie 58, Ilmarinen, Lieto. It is organized by Liedon Luja, TUL V-S.

name: Pirkan Hölkkä & Kieppi
description: The autumn season’s fitness highlight, Pirkan Hölkkä, will be run on Sunday, 5 October 2025, for the 55th time. Pirkan Kieppi, a 14 km event, is held alongside Pirkan Hölkkä. It starts at 11:30 from the Pirkan Hölkkä finish area, in the yard of TAKK’s Nirva campus. The approximately 14 km Pirkan Kieppi through the beautiful autumn scenery of Vuores and Hervanta is suitable for anyone with a good basic level of fitness. There is no rush at the event, and participants can enjoy being outdoors and the refreshments provided at the aid stations.

name: Paraisten Lenkki
description: Come celebrate the 60th anniversary run of the Pargas Run with us on Sunday, October 6, 2024. The race follows the traditional 10.35 km course, starting and finishing at Pajbacka Sports Field, which also has changing rooms and showers. To mark the occasion, all participants will receive a gold commemorative medal and a unique Pargas Run T-shirt. After the finish, coffee, juice, and layer cake will be served to all participants.

images.alt_text: Juoksija-lehden kansi, jossa juoksija juoksee polulla.

name: Fiskarsin Maraton Rasepori
description: Fiskars Marathon Rasepori will be held on 20.06.2025 in Raseborg, starting from the Fiskari Athletes’ lodge at Kalliomäentie 4. The race starts at 10:00, and the race office opens at 8:30. Several distances are available: 15 km, 7 km, 2 km and 0.6 km for different age groups. The route winds through beautiful scenery along gravel roads, giving runners the chance to enjoy nature and peaceful trails.

name: Nuuksio Pikkujoulu Ultra
description: Nuuksio Pikkujoulu Ultra takes place on Saturday, November 16, 2024, at Folkhälsan Solvalla Sports Institute, starting at 9:00 a.m. The competition category follows the backyard-style format, with simultaneous starts; the final start is at 4:00 p.m. and the finish closes at 5:00 p.m. In the recreational category, you can run at your own pace for as many laps as you like. There is also a shortened course of approximately 5 km, offering the atmosphere of a mass start. This event is a great opportunity to try ultrarunning amid the beautiful scenery of Nuuksio. Refreshments include mulled berry juice, warm juice, gingerbread cookies, and other light snacks.

name: Teivocup I
description: Teivo Cup I was run on 26 November 2011 in sunny weather, with temperatures a few degrees above zero. The race had 80 runners, who competed on a route that was icy in places. There was a good turnout in the youth categories. In the girls’ 11-year-old category, Mila Manninen (KU-68) ran the fastest time, 4:10. In the boys’ 11-year-old category, Miska Manninen (KU-68) was the fastest in 4:13. In the men’s 5 km, Jarkko Järvenpää improved the previous course record by two seconds, running 14:54.

name: Teivocup
description: Teivocup is a winter-season test-run race series held around Teivo Racecourse once a month from November to April. Each race is 5 km, with men’s and women’s categories. The second race of the current season will take place on Saturday, 13 December 2025, followed by a Christmas party for members in the Takkahuone at Lamminpää Lodge from 14:00 to 18:00.

images.alt_text: Talvinen juoksukilpailu, jossa juoksijat juoksevat lumisella radalla.
Teivo Ravikeskus logo hevosen päällä, koristeltu kukilla ja laakerinlehdillä.

name: Radioaseman Maraton
description: The Radioaseman Ultra Marathon (100 km) was held in Pori on 23 September 2023, on the Itä-Pori fitness trail at Radioasemantie 1, 28330 Pori. The route was 2 km long and ran around Pori’s old shortwave radio station. The event offered several distances: 100 km, 50 miles, 50 km as a team, 50 km individual, marathon 42.2 km, and half marathon 21.1 km.

images.alt_text: Nainen poseeraa palkinnon ja välipalan kanssa Radioaseman Ultra Maraton -juoksutapahtumassa.

name: Haaga Run
description: Haaga Run will be held for the ninth time on 8 November 2025! The event is organized in collaboration by Runner's High and FC POHU. The distances are 5 km and 10 km, and the start is at Lassila Sports Park (Laurinniitynpolku 2, 00440 Helsinki).

name: Nummela Backyard Ultra
description: Welcome to follow the sold-out event at Nummelanharju! The event takes place on October 11, 2025, starting at 10:00 at Nummelanharju in Vihti. This is a Silver competition, whose winner earns a direct spot in the 2026 Satellite World Championships. The winner receives a €500 cash prize, and second place receives €300. All participants will receive a NUBU sauna bench towel and a wooden participation medal.

images.alt_text: Nummela Backyard Ultra -reitin kartta. Hyvälaatuisen kartan avulla näet reitin.
Nummelan Backyard Ultra -reitin kartta. Reitti kulkee Nummelanharjulla.

name: Hercules Trail Run 11.10
description: Hercules Trail Run, held for the ninth time, invites runners to Porvoo’s stunning trails! The day begins with the children’s Polkuralli, where those born in 2013–2025 can run a 2 km route through the beautiful natural surroundings of the Mustijoki River. One hour later, the 7 km, 14 km and 21 km races start in staggered waves. The route is designed for runners and outdoor enthusiasts of all levels, offering a unique opportunity to enjoy Porvoo’s finest trails on the second Saturday of October.

images.alt_text: Kaksi juoksijaa polulla metsässä Hercules Trail Runia varten.
Lasten juoksukilpailun lähtöviivalla, ilmapallukoristeet ja luonto taustalla.

name: NAMI-matka
description: The NAMI run takes place on Saturday, 11 October 2025, at 9:00 at the Kyötikkälä Sports Centre in Kangasala. There are several distances to choose from: 100 km, 50 km, the marathon, and a nonstop option where you can run as many kilometres as you like. The course is precisely measured at 2 km, and refreshments are always close by. All runners are offered soup and coffee at the finish, and participants receive a medal.

name: Suojuoksun Elämyskisa
description: We are pleased to announce that construction work on the solar power plant being built at Ojassuo will once again allow the Suojuoksu to be held this year. The Suojuoksu will take place at Ojassuo in Kauklaisten on Saturday, 12 October 2024 at 1 p.m. Come and challenge yourself and your running fitness at this slightly different running event, and experience a running event like no other. Welcome, whether you’re coming from near or far, and whether you’re a seasoned runner or a first-timer!

name: Joutenlammen Jotos
description: Joutenlammen Jotos is an accessible outdoor event for all ages, where you can choose how to take part. Runners can enter a timed 10-kilometre race, which requires advance registration. The entry fee is 20 euros and includes soup for lunch, childcare during the race, and the chance to use the sauna. There is also a free run for children, along with fun arts and crafts and play activities.

name: Joensuu Night Run
description: Joensuu Night Run 12h is run on an officially measured 325.336-metre mondo track in Joensuu on 16–17 November 2024. The race starts on Saturday at 20:00 and ends at 8:00 on Sunday morning, with the running direction changed every three hours. The event is an IAU Bronze Label competition, with women’s and men’s categories and a minimum age of 18.

images.alt_text: Joensuun yöjuoksun kuva kilpailijoista radalla. Tulostietoja näkyvissä.

name: Talvisarjajuoksu Rovaniemi
description: The traditional RDS Winter Series Run is back! The first race will take place on Saturday, 4 October at 11:00 on the familiar and safe Koskenkylä route. The third race in the Winter Series Run will be held on Saturday, 13 December 2025 at 11:00 on the Koskenkylä route. New this year: a 2 km fitness category open to everyone.

images.alt_text: Talvinen juoksutapahtuma Rovaniemellä, juoksijoita lähtöviivalla. RDS-logo näkyy.

name: Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup 1
description: The MKFacade Road Running Cup was run in beautiful but windy weather, with 347 runners taking part. A total of 412 people registered for the first race, 233 of whom had purchased a race pass before registration day. There were 179 late entries, which caused a little congestion, but 347 runners ultimately received a result.

images.alt_text: Ryhmä juoksijoita juoksemassa tiellä aurinkoisessa säässä.

name: Forssan Puistojuoksu ja -kävely
description: Forssa Park Run, which gets the whole city moving, has been bringing runners together for 30 years. Held once a month, the park run always attracts 100–200 runners of different ages. The beautiful route winds through the scenery along the Loimijoki River, and participants can choose between a 5.8 km and an 11.2 km route. It passes near the centre of Forssa, through the park at the old cotton mill and along the Loimijoki River. The start and finish are on Keskuskatu, in front of Elävien kuvien, a cinema more than 100 years old.

images.alt_text: Kolme ihmistä juoksee ulkona polulla lähellä jokea, Forssan Puistojuoksu.
Kolme ihmistä juoksemassa puistossa lähellä jokea.
Kaunis maisema joen varrelta. Silta ja luonto. Forssan Puistojuoksun reitti.
Ryhmä juoksijoita Forssan Lehden Puistojuoksussa, osa kisa-asussa.

name: Kaarinan Syysmaraton
description: Kaarina Autumn Marathon is run on an approximately 10.5-kilometre loop through the beautiful, flat terrain of Kaarina and Piikkiö. All distances—10 km, half marathon and marathon—are officially measured. Race headquarters are located at Valkeavuori School, and the event takes place on 18 October 2025. Everyone who finishes their fifth marathon receives a silver medal, and those who finish their tenth receive a gold medal.

images.alt_text: Kaarinan Syysmaratonin juoksijat lähtöviivalla.  Hyvä tunnelma!

name: Kankaanpää Maraton
description: Kankaanpää Marathon is a versatile running event offering participants several different distances. The event includes a marathon (42.195 km), a half marathon (21.1 km), and a 10 km run. The course is designed to offer beautiful scenery and varied terrain, making the run both enjoyable and challenging. The marathon course is officially measured and meets international standards, making it possible for competitors to set personal records.

images.alt_text: Juoksutapahtuma. Ihmisiä ulkona, joillakin juoksutapahtumaan liittyviä vaatteita.

name: Pukinmaki Run 1/2 Maraton 10k 5k
description: Pukinmäki Run is an annual running event held in the Pukinmäki district of Helsinki. The officially measured distances are 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, as well as a 1 km children's race. The course loops around the boundaries of Pukinmäki on flat roads and paths, approximately 85% of which are paved. It is a fast course with only 4.9 metres of elevation gain, making it ideal for all runners.

images.alt_text: Juoksijat juoksevat asfaltilla sateisessa päivässä, Pukinmäki Run tapahtumassa.
Pukinmäki Run reittikartta, näyttää reitin ja sen pääkohdat.

name: Köykkyri NUTS
description: NUTS Köykkyri is a relaxed but lively trail running event where you take on Köykkyrin Hill and enjoy good company. Expect hill training, sweat, and a festive pre-Christmas atmosphere, elf-runner style! Experience the thrill of Kempele’s “high altitude” and the true excitement of hill running, with 25 meters of elevation gain. Get ready to dash across the “summit” of Kempele, where every climb is a celebration and every descent deserves applause.

images.alt_text: NUTS Köykkyri polkujuoksukilpailun kuva. Juoksijat juoksevat metsäpolulla.
NUTS Köykkyri -polkujuoksun reitti kartalla. Viisi eri lenkkiä.

name: Lepokallion Lenkki Polkujuoksu
description: Lepokallion Lenkki trail run will be held in Ylistaro on Saturday, November 2, at 11:00. The event offers varied terrain amid beautiful scenery, with trails and natural areas providing runners with stunning views and challenges. Several distances are available, including 5.6 km and 10.8 km, suitable for both beginners and more experienced runners.

name: Sarvilahden Maraton
description: The Sarvilahti Marathon will be held on 25 October 2025 at Rauhala Park in Loviisa. The event offers several races, including a marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km, as well as a 1.6 km children’s course. The marathon consists of two laps of an officially measured half-marathon course. Parking is at the Loviisa Ice Hall, with signs directing participants to the start in the park, about 400 metres away.

images.alt_text: Ryhmä juoksijoita juoksee kilpailussa, jossa on numeroituja kilpailijoita.

name: Helsinki Halloween Run
description: Helsinki Halloween Run is a relaxed Halloween-themed running event for runners of all levels. In 2025, the event takes place on October 25 in Kalasatama, Helsinki! The new route winds through Kalasatama’s urban surroundings and consists of a 5 km loop, run once for the 5 km race and twice for the 10 km race. You can take part competitively against the clock or dress up in your most outrageous Halloween costume.

images.alt_text: Helsingin Halloween-juoksussa osallistujat mime-asussa. Hauska kuva!

name: Tuusula Trailrun
description: Tuusula Trailrun 2024 is a trail running race held on Sunday, 27 October 2024 at 11:00 at the biathlon stadium of Tuusula Sports Centre. The race course winds along the trails of Tuusula Korpikylä and Sammaloja and is marked with blue-and-yellow tape and signs. The entry fee includes the trail race, chip timing, a hot soup and a drink, and access to shower facilities at the ice rink.

images.alt_text: Ryhmä juoksijoita juoksemassa asfaltilla, metsä taustalla.

name: Hiidenhölkkä Nummela
description: As autumn approaches, so does the traditional Hiidenhölkkä, organized this year for the 47th time by Nummelan Tarmo. The Hiidenhölkkä routes—the 10 km and 20 km (2 × 10 km) runs—loop around Nummelanharju and Nummela Airport. Hiidenhölkkä starts at 12:00 and the running event ends at 14:00.

name: Rantasaunan Lenkki
description: Rantasaunan Lenkki and Osmo Runs take place on Friday, June 8. The Osmo Runs start at 6:00 p.m., and runners are placed in age categories. After registration, runners are assigned to suitable heats, and race numbers are handed out at around 6:00 p.m. The Hintrekin run starts at 7:30 p.m. Prizes are awarded after the races, including a prize donated by Avain Säästöpankki, and ice cream is provided to all participants.

images.alt_text: Juoksija maalissa kohottaa nyrkkiä ja hymyilee.

name: Järvenpään Maraton
description: The Järvenpää Marathon has been held since 1994. The half marathon and marathon courses are officially measured and run mainly on a paved shared-use path around Lake Tuusula. For the first time, the route follows Tuusula’s Rantatie, offering cultural experiences for both runners and spectators. The area has excellent transport connections, and there is plenty of parking nearby. Welcome to Tuusula and Järvenpää!

name: Itsenäisyysmaraton
description: In 2025, Itsenäisyysmaraton celebrates its 44th year and will be held on Saturday, 06.12, in Kuopio at Väinölänniemi. Several distances are offered, including the marathon, half marathon, minimarathon, and the Kultajousi Running 10 km and 5 km races. The route is 5.27 km long, flat, and runs on sand and asphalt. A refreshment station provides runners with water and juice. Participants can register in advance or on race day.

name: Backyardish Ultra
description: Backyardish Ultra Kuopio follows the traditional backyard ultra format, but it is not an official backyard ultra. The route is a marked loop of approximately 6.7 kilometres through the forest. The event takes place in Neulamäki on Saturday, 16 November 2024, from 9:00 to 21:00. All participants start their first lap at 9:00, and subsequent laps start on the hour. The winner is the first person to finish the final lap. There is no winner if nobody completes the final lap.

images.alt_text: Metsässä juoksevia ihmisiä polulla, juoksukilpailuun liittyvä kuva.

name: Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup 2/5
description: Finland’s largest road running series, Vantaa Road Running Cup, starts again on Saturday at Sotunki School, which returns as the event centre after a few years’ break. The event has a 32-year history, and this year’s new main sponsor is MK FACADE OY. On Saturday, runners will compete over 5 km and 10 km, with starts at 13:00 and 13:10. The route is designed to provide runners with a pleasant and safe environment, and enhanced supervision will ensure safety during the race.

images.alt_text: Juoksukilpailu Vantaalla, jossa joukko ihmisiä juoksee asfaltilla. Taustalla rakennuksia ja puita.

name: Talvisarjajuoksu Rovaniemi
description: The traditional RDS Winter Series Run is back! The first race will take place on Saturday, 4 October at 11:00 on the familiar and safe Koskenkylä route. The third race in the Winter Series will be run on Saturday, 13 December 2025 at 11:00 on the Koskenkylä route. New this year: a 2 km fitness race open to everyone.

name: Teivocup II
description: Teivocup is a winter-season series of test runs, offering the opportunity to take part in running races at all levels, from recreational runners to competitive athletes. The event is held in Ylöjärvi, near the Teivo Race Centre, and is aimed at everyone who enjoys endurance sports. Each race is 5 km, and runners can register on site. The entry fee is €10 per race (€7 for club members). The second race will take place on Saturday, 13 December 2025, followed by a Christmas party for members at Lamminpää Lodge.

name: Forssan Puistojuoksu
description: Forssa Park Run is an event that gets the whole city moving and has been bringing runners together for 30 years. Held once a month, it typically attracts 100–200 runners of all ages. The beautiful route winds through the scenery along the Loimijoki River. Runners can choose between a 5.8 km and an 11.2 km course, which passes near Forssa city centre through the park of the old cotton mill. The start and finish are on Keskuskatu, in front of the more than 100-year-old Elävien Kuvien cinema.

images.alt_text: Kolme juoksijaa Forssan Puistojuoksussa kauniilla reitillä.
Forssan Puistojuoksun 2024 kausikortti. Juoksijoita ja aikataulu.
Forssan Puistojuoksun kausikortti 2023. Juoksijoita ja kilpailukalenteri.

name: Buugin Pamaus Juoksu
description: Welcome to the first-ever feel-good New Year’s run at Buugi Sports Centre on 31 December 2024 at 18:00! The event is organised jointly by Buugi Sports Centre and Hippoksen Marathon Club, with the aim of offering the best way in Central Finland to start celebrating the New Year in good company with a run and a buffet meal. Participants can choose the 10 km distance, with competitive and recreational categories for women and men.

images.alt_text: Juoksija punaisella juoksuradalla. Hyvän mielen uuden vuoden juoksu.

name: Uudenvuodenjuoksu
location: Tanelinrannan nuoriso- ja urheilukeskus, Lampitie 10, Seinäjoki
distance_verbose: 10 km, 10 km, 8.2 km, 7.6 km, 5 km, 5 km, 5 km, 5 km, 2.4 km, 1.2 km
description: The New Year’s Run is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy exercise on New Year’s Eve. The event takes place on 31 December 2024 at various locations, including Seinäjoki, Liminka, Lieto and Imatra, and offers participants a range of distances for runners of different ages and abilities. The courses are officially measured and safe, with traffic marshals. The event brings together running enthusiasts and also offers the chance to enjoy coffee and refreshments from kiosks in the area.

name: Talvijuoksu Lappeenranta
description: Talvijuoksusarja is a winter running event held in Lappeenranta. The event starts and finishes beside Pallo Sports Hall at Tukkikatu 2. Registration takes place at the starting point 20 minutes before the start. Distances offered are 3 km, 5 km, and 7 km. Children can run an approximately 1 km distance. All routes are out-and-back courses along a lit cycle path. The event is free and open to everyone. The temperature limit is -15 C.

name: Talvijuoksusarja 3/6
description: The 3rd event in the Winter Running Series will take place on 30.12.2023 in Mikkeli, offering runners the opportunity to participate in different distances, including 10 km and 6 km. The event is designed especially for winter conditions and attracts both competitive and recreational runners. Previous races have seen excellent performances, and participants can enjoy the winter running atmosphere.

images.alt_text: KOMIA Talvijuoksusarjan 3/6 osakilpailu Mikkelissä. Juoksijat maantiellä.

name: Forssan Puistojuoksu
description: Forssa Park Run has been promoting the city’s fitness for 30 years. Each month, 100–200 runners of different ages take part. The beautiful route runs through the scenery along the Loimijoki River, with a choice of distances: 5.8 km or 11.2 km. The start and finish are on Keskuskatu, in front of the over-100-year-old Elävien kuvien cinema.

name: Teivocup III 2027
description: Teivocup III 2027 is a six-part training competition and test-run series held once a month from November to April. The event offers running opportunities for different age and competition categories, with distances of 5 km and 2 km. The course follows a pedestrian and cycling path, with the start and finish at the intersection by Teivo Trotting Centre. Registration takes place at Lamminpää Outdoor Centre, and the race starts at 12:00. The best runners are awarded.
course_highlights: The course follows a pedestrian and cycling path
Start and finish at the intersection by Teivo Trotting Centre
Distances of 5 km and 2 km for different categories
additional: Register at Lamminpää Outdoor Centre by 11:30; arriving early is recommended to avoid queues. Categories: 5 km M/M40/M50/N/N40/N50; 2 km P/T 09/11/13. The best runners are awarded. A six-part running series; registration opens at 11:30 and the race starts at 12:00.

name: Teivocup IV 2027
description: Teivocup IV 2027 is a six-part series of training races and test runs held once a month from November to April. The event’s fourth race takes place on February 6 at Lamminpää Outdoor Recreation Lodge in Ylöjärvi. The series offers several distances for different age groups and divisions, and the route follows a pedestrian and cycle path near the Teivo Race Centre junction. Registration is on site by 11:30, and the start is at 12:00. The top runners will be awarded prizes.
course_highlights: The route follows a pedestrian and cycle path
Start and finish at the Teivo Race Centre junction
Several distances for different age groups and divisions (5 km and 2 km)
additional: Registration is on site at Lamminpää Outdoor Recreation Lodge by 11:30. The distances are 5 km (M/M40/M50/N/N40/N50) and 2 km (P/T 09/11/13). With several competition classes, the event offers an opportunity to take part in winter running in Finnish nature.

name: LAPONIE Boreal Winter-Trail Trail To Be Alive
description: Laponie Boreal Winter-Trail is a unique winter adventure in Inari, offering participants the chance to experience Arctic nature and the Northern Lights. This winter trail-running event takes runners through stunning scenery in the Lapland wilderness, offering unforgettable experiences immersed in nature. The event is part of the Trail to Be Alive series, known for its high-quality and memorable trail races around the world. Runners can expect a challenging but rewarding course that combines the tranquillity of nature with the beauty of winter.
course_highlights: Arctic winter wilderness in Inari
A chance to see the Northern Lights
A challenging trail-running course immersed in nature
additional: The event is part of an international trail tour, but further details about the course or registration are not available.

name: Teivocup V 2027
description: Teivocup V is a winter test-run race series held around Teivo racecourse once a month from November to April. The race covers a 5 km route and is open to runners of all abilities, from recreational runners to competitive athletes. Registration takes place on site at least one hour before the start. The entry fee is €10 per event, or €7 for club members. The series has men’s and women’s categories as well as a team competition.
course_highlights: 5 km running route around Teivo racecourse
Winter race series running from November to April
Suitable for runners of all abilities, from recreational runners to competitive athletes
additional: Registration takes place on site at least one hour before the start. The series has men’s and women’s categories as well as a team competition. The event offers the chance to take part in a 5 km run and join the Finnish running community. Entry fees and further details are not currently available.

name: Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup 4/5
description: Vantaa Road Running Cup is Finland’s largest and fastest winter running series, offering accessible road races in Hakunila, Vantaa. The series consists of five events, with 5 km and 10 km distances. The races attract a wide range of participants and are run on officially measured courses in sunny spring weather. Buying a series pass makes it easy to take part in all the events without registering separately each time. The event has a long tradition and also offers the opportunity to join running classes and coaching.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km and 10 km courses in Hakunila, Vantaa
Fast, high-quality winter races
Races are held in sunny spring weather and attract a wide range of participants
additional: A series pass covers all five events, with no separate registration required. Race numbers must be collected from the race office and returned after each race. Changing distance is possible at the information desk up to half an hour before the start. Members of Kenttäurheilijat-58 ry can take part with a series pass at no cost once their membership fee has been paid. Exact event details and results; no direct mention of the price or any special course features.

name: Komian kirkon hölkkä
description: Komian Kirkon Jog is a running event organized by Ylistaron Kilpa-Veljet ry in the Ylistaro area. The event offers a variety of distances, including 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, on scenic routes with changing landscapes. It is popular with locals and offers a good opportunity to test your fitness in early spring. The event is part of Ylistaron Kilpa-Veljet ry’s active event calendar and orienteering activities.
course_highlights: Varied routes: 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon
Beautiful and diverse terrain in the Ylistaro area
Route maps available for the 5 km and half marathon/10 km routes
additional: Race instructions for runners, spectators, support crew and volunteer helpers are available on the race information page. Results and registered participants can be viewed online. Route maps are available in PDF format for the 5 km and half marathon/10 km routes. The event takes place on 4 April 2027 and includes various race and participation options. Results and more information are available on the event website.

name: Arctic Marathon
description: Arctic Marathon offers a unique running experience amid the magnificent scenery of Finnish Lapland. Choose from a marathon, half marathon or 10 km distance, all taking you through Arctic nature. Participants stay in four-star Finnish cabins with saunas and enjoy full board and a range of activities, including husky safaris, ice swimming and Northern Lights viewing. The event combines sport and adventure in a unique way and is part of the international Wildmarathon series.
course_highlights: 42 km marathon route through the nature of Finnish Lapland
You can also run the 21 km half marathon or 10 km distance
The route passes through an Arctic setting where you may see the Northern Lights
additional: The event includes airport transfers from Rovaniemi to Santa Claus Holiday Village, accommodation in four-star cabins with saunas, all meals, an awards ceremony, a husky safari, ice swimming and the chance to see the Northern Lights. The programme also includes a post-run sauna and cool-down activity, as well as time to relax. The run starts at Santa Claus Holiday Village. The terrain includes snowy roads and forest tracks. Temperatures range from -12°C to -7°C. Recommended gear includes spikes and thermal clothing. Registration includes accommodation, meals, transfers and Arctic experiences.

name: Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup 5/5
description: The Vantaa Road Running Cup is Finland’s largest and fastest winter running series, consisting of five events in Hakunila and Tikkurila, Vantaa. The races offer accessible road-running competitions, with the option to enter using a series pass or by paying for a single race. The route runs around Sotunki Upper Secondary School, which also serves as the event centre. At the final event, the top runners in each category are awarded prizes based on points, and runners are also encouraged with bonuses for course records. The event is open to runners of all levels and also includes a running school with coaching.
course_highlights: The route runs around Sotunki Upper Secondary School in Vantaa
Sotunki Upper Secondary School serves as the event centre, with changing rooms and showers
Sports drinks are available at the finish area, along with a café
additional: A series pass lets you take part in all five events without registering separately. Race numbers are collected from the race office and returned after each race. Prizes are awarded based on points after the final event, and runners must take part in at least two events to qualify for overall prizes. The running school offers coaching and training sessions, and members can participate in the road-running cup for free by claiming a pass in advance. The event is held in Tikkurila, Vantaa, and includes several races, such as the 5K and 10K. These popular local events offer accessible road-running races.

name: Valio Helsinki City Run
description: Valio Helsinki City Run is Finland’s largest running event, bringing more than 24,000 runners from over 110 countries to Helsinki Olympic Stadium and the city streets. The event offers six different running distances, including a marathon, half marathon, marathon relay, 5 km run and walk, and the children’s Minimarathon. The routes are scenic and coastal, and the finish is at Olympic Stadium. The event also offers a wide range of services, such as world-class timekeeping, refreshment stations, and free entry to the Swimming Stadium after the run.
course_highlights: Scenic coastal routes in Helsinki
Finish and event centre at Olympic Stadium
Officially measured, AIMS-certified routes
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Olympic Stadium before the race. Payment with sports benefits is available (ePassi, Edenred, Zevoy Benefits). Group registration requires at least 5 runners. Groups of at least 10 people receive free event shirts. Free entry to the Swimming Stadium after the run. Refreshment stations and gels along the route. Cancellation insurance is available for purchase. Free group training sessions and training plans. World-class timekeeping (excluding the walk). The event includes several distances, such as the marathon, half marathon, 5 km run, and walking events. Participants can follow live results and get their certificates as soon as they finish. The event takes place at Olympic Stadium and also includes an event week with activities and sponsorship opportunities.

name: RAHOLAN KYMPPI (TAMPERE)
location: Tampereen Tesoman jäähallin parkkipaikka, Tampere, Pirkanmaa, Finland
description: Raholan Kymppi is an annual 10-kilometre running event starting from the parking lot of Tesoma Ice Hall in Tampere. It gives runners the chance to enjoy a course that is traditional and popular with locals. The event is part of the running calendar organised by Team Rahola and attracts a diverse range of participants. It is a good opportunity to test your fitness in spring and experience the sense of community at a running event.
course_highlights: A 10-kilometre course
Start and finish at the parking lot of Tesoma Ice Hall in Tampere
A traditional local running event popular with the community
additional: Team Rahola's Monday group runs from Tesoma Ice Hall at 18:00 offer an opportunity to train. No specific start times or prices are listed for the running event. Team Rahola also offers other running events and training sessions, such as the Cooper test and weekly events. The event takes place at the parking lot of Tesoma Ice Hall in Tampere, and participants can run or walk. The event offers a chance to enjoy exercise in surroundings that combine nature and the city.

name: Kaldoaivi Ultra Trail
description: Kaldoaivi Ultra Trail is the world’s northernmost ultra-running event, held in Utsjoki, in the Lapland wilderness. The route climbs to the summits of Kaldoaivi’s highest fells and offers spectacular, challenging scenery. The race tests runners’ endurance and skills in demanding natural terrain, but rewards them with an experience that brings many back year after year. The event also includes mountain bike races and offers a range of options for participants of different levels.
course_highlights: The route climbs to the summits of Kaldoaivi’s highest fells
Spectacular, rugged Lapland wilderness scenery
A demanding and instructive trail route
additional: Registering for two days gives a 30% discount on the price of the lower-priced category. The entry fee includes drinks and energy supplies at aid stations, washing facilities, transport of a gear bag to the finish, a race number, timing, a Kaldoaivi Ultra Trail lightweight backpack, a KUT product and a Finisher pendant. Category changes and transfers are free of charge until 7.7.2027. The event centres and start locations are in Nuorgam and Utsjoki. The race schedule includes several start times for different distances on 23.7. and 24.7.2027. Participant limits vary by distance; for example, MTB & E-MTB 57 km: 100 participants, Trailrun 168 km: 100 participants. The event offers several distances, including trail running, mountain biking and road cycling, with no amenities along the route. Participation includes a race number, timing chip, lightweight backpack and Finisher pendant. The event takes place in July 2027; detailed schedules and registration information are available on the website.
